violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. Cutting board at toaster melted and discolored. Replace as needed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Pooling water and food debris under ice machine. Needs cleaning. Food debris under shelving units in walk ins. Needs cleaning.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Reach in freezer has cracked and damaged surfaces. Needs repair.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Detail cleaning needed to lower storage shelving, reach in cooler doors, and reach in freezer.
